trend.summary: An Oct 27, 2026 roundup of popular AI video generators notes that on some services generations still count against your credits even when you discard the result, and advises tracking the money and time needed for one usable result.

sources.title: 10 Popular AI Video Generators: Prices, Free Plans and Business Uses (FinChannel)

angle: Retakes are free when the render runs on your own computer: funkbox has no credits and no accounts, so you change a line in the shot list and render again. No NVIDIA GPU needed.

claims.text: FUNKBOX RENDERS ON YOUR OWN COMPUTER
